{{Top|leg}}
'''Uldyr''' was the rainy season on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. Although [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]] were a rarity on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] planet, once or twice a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] enough moisture built up in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] to trigger several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] of rain. Uldyr was an [[Olys Corellisi/Legends|Olys Corellisi]] term translating to "mucking out."<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>

During uldyr, the deserts of Socorro became quagmires and filled with quicksand pits. Residents of the planet moved to the highland areas and stay inside as much as possible to remain safe. Once the rain clouds cleared, the presence of [[Sokor/Legends|Sokor]], the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Star/Legends|sun]], dried the surface of the planet in twenty-four [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]]. The season triggered the growth cycle for the [[Zsajhira berry|Zsajhira]] plant that lasted for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="BSS" />
